WITH RECURSIVE
web_daily AS (
    SELECT
        ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_date,
        sum(ws_sales_price) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim
        ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
      AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk, d_date
),
web_v1(item_sk, d_date, cume_sales) AS (
    SELECT
        d.item_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.cume_sales
    FROM web_daily AS d
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_daily AS p
        WHERE p.item_sk = d.item_sk
          AND p.d_date < d.d_date
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        web.item_sk,
        d.d_date,
        CASE
            WHEN web.cume_sales IS NULL THEN d.cume_sales
            WHEN d.cume_sales IS NULL THEN web.cume_sales
            ELSE web.cume_sales + d.cume_sales
        END
    FROM web_v1 AS web
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            web_daily.item_sk,
            web_daily.d_date,
            web_daily.cume_sales
        FROM web_daily
        WHERE web_daily.item_sk = web.item_sk
          AND web_daily.d_date > web.d_date
        ORDER BY web_daily.d_date
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS d
        ON d.item_sk = web.item_sk
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT
        ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_date,
        sum(ss_sales_price) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim
        ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
      AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, d_date
),
store_v1(item_sk, d_date, cume_sales) AS (
    SELECT
        d.item_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.cume_sales
    FROM store_daily AS d
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_daily AS p
        WHERE p.item_sk = d.item_sk
          AND p.d_date < d.d_date
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        store.item_sk,
        d.d_date,
        CASE
            WHEN store.cume_sales IS NULL THEN d.cume_sales
            WHEN d.cume_sales IS NULL THEN store.cume_sales
            ELSE store.cume_sales + d.cume_sales
        END
    FROM store_v1 AS store
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            store_daily.item_sk,
            store_daily.d_date,
            store_daily.cume_sales
        FROM store_daily
        WHERE store_daily.item_sk = store.item_sk
          AND store_daily.d_date > store.d_date
        ORDER BY store_daily.d_date
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS d
        ON d.item_sk = store.item_sk
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        item_sk,
        d_date,
        web_sales,
        store_sales,
        max(web_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY item_sk
            ORDER BY d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS web_cumulative,
        max(store_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY item_sk
            ORDER BY d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN web.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN web.item_sk
                ELSE store.item_sk
            END AS item_sk,
            CASE
                WHEN web.d_date IS NOT NULL THEN web.d_date
                ELSE store.d_date
            END AS d_date,
            web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
            store.cume_sales AS store_sales
        FROM store_v1 AS store
        FULL OUTER JOIN web_v1 AS web
            ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk
           AND web.d_date = store.d_date
    ) AS x
) AS y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
